relations.rationale: Nell being older than Kira does not establish whether Leo is the oldest overall.
Nell's age relative to Kira has no bearing on Leo's afternoon activities.
Nell's relative age has nothing to do with the color of Noor's robot.
Nell's age relative to Kira does not relate to the number of parts in Kira's or Ivo's designs.
Nell's age compared to Kira has no bearing on how well Kira's and Ivo's designs performed.
Ivo being taller than Nell does not indicate anything about his height relative to Noor.
Ivo's height relative to Nell has no connection to whether Leo drove the minibus.
Height comparison between Ivo and Nell doesn't inform who is the oldest participant.
Ivo's height relative to Nell is unrelated to Leo's activity of helping newer members.
Ivo being taller than Nell has no relevance to the color of Noor's robot.
Height comparison between Ivo and Nell is unrelated to the number of parts in Kira's or Ivo's design.
Ivo's height relative to Nell has no bearing on the trial performance of Kira's and Ivo's designs.
Ivo's height relative to Noor has no connection to whether Leo drove the minibus.
Height comparison between Ivo and Noor doesn't inform who is the oldest participant.
Ivo's height relative to Noor is unrelated to Leo's afternoon activity.
Ivo being taller than Noor says nothing about the color of Noor's robot.
Height comparison between Ivo and Noor is unrelated to the number of parts in Kira's or Ivo's design.
Ivo's height relative to Noor has no bearing on how Kira's and Ivo's designs performed in trials.
Leo not driving the minibus does not indicate whether he is the oldest participant.
Leo not driving the minibus does not indicate anything about him helping newer members solder wires.
